text_block_list.text: Today is Valentine's Day. Smiling warmly at the restless Umamusume, I arrived at the trainer's office, when...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
P-Please...
take this...! ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I put my whole heart
and soul into this for you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: "Will you... savor my feelings...?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Hold on, hold on~!?
That's just too much, isn't it!?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Is that really any way to speak to an Umamusume
who plucked up the courage to come here~?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Good grief.
If this is a joke, I'm not laughing~!
I wasn't joking; that was just my deduction based on Seiun Sky's usual behavior... but it seems she's actually being serious this time.
choice_data_list: So it really is chocolate, huh?
So it really is chocolate after all!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That's what I've been telling you~!
choice_data_list: Sorry about that, but thank you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Geez.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, as your penalty!
You better give me a great reaction when you look inside, okay?
"I slowly opened the box given to me by Seiun Sky. Inside, there was—"
(Flop-flop-flop!!)

A huge fish leaped out
right before my eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nyahaha, you fell for it~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you got it totally right☆
It was actually a jack-in-the-box~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, that reaction was even better than I hoped...
Hehe, ahahaha...♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You really are the absolute
best, Trainer... Ahahaha!

Afterward, a cheerful Seiun Sky gave me
the chocolates that had been sitting at the bottom
of the jack-in-the-box after all...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, Trainer-san,
you can be pretty dense sometimes~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Couldn't you show at least a little bashfulness
or something like that~?"

...Having been teased so much,
I felt the urge to talk back a little.
So—
choice_data_list: You weren't giving it your all, were you?
You weren't giving it your all, were you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: Try making me blush for real.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehh, what's that about?
Sounds like a pain, I don't wanna~."
choice_data_list: That might be a bit tough for Seiun Sky~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Hooh?
Are you trying to butter up Sei-chan here?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped! I'll play along.
In return, I'm going to embarrass you without mercy!
...And so, for some reason, I was called out behind the school building again in the evening.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah... You came.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Um... listen?
There's something I wanted to tell you today.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You know... I've felt this way
about you... for a long time...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—This is so stupid~.
Yeah, forget it, I quit!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you blush doesn't really
do anything for Sei-chan anyway~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So I quit! Too bad I couldn't
get to see Sei-chan get serious!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, right.
Just so you know, though.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
The chocolates I gave you are kinda homemade, so...
...If you don't savor them, I'll never forgive you!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Just kidding☆
Seiun Sky, fickle to the very end, walked away with somewhat brisk steps...
